{{Vanilla|Vindicator Spawn Egg}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''raw diamond''' drops from diamond ore and appears in chest loot. It must be smelted in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] to become a [[Diamond|diamond]].
